next.reason: KEPT: §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR18 'The minimum and maximum record sizes for a file are established at the time the file is created and must not subsequently be changed.' 2023 says it in prose with no catalog row (kb/Work PB479): §2023:9.1.6 'A physical file has several attributes that apply to the file at the time it is created and cannot be changed throughout the lifetime of the file', among them 'the minimum and maximum logical record size in bytes' (and §2023:3.88, a fixed file attribute 'is established when the physical file is created and is never changed'). The catalogued rules that state parts of it: §2023:9.1.13.2 GR3 names 'the minimum or maximum length of records allowed for the fixed file attributes for that file'; §2023:14.9.27.4 GR10 holds an existing file to them at OPEN (its attributes 'are compared with the fixed file attributes of the file. If the attributes don't match, a file attribute conflict condition occurs, the execution of the OPEN statement is unsuccessful'), with status 39 (§2023:9.1.13.6 GR7 'a conflict has been detected between the fixed file attributes and the attributes specified for that file in the source unit'; 1985 the same for an indexed file, §1985:IX.1.3.4 'I-O Status = 39'). Both editions leave to the implementor which attributes OPEN validates (§1985:IX.4.4.4 GR8 'The implementor defines which of the fixed file attributes are validated during the execution of the OPEN statement'; §2023:14.9.27.4 GR10). Same requirement.
